mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_demo_order(id,demo_no,request_key,user_id,amount,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{demoNo},#{key},#{userId},#{amount},'CREATED',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment_demo_order WHERE request_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM payment_demo_order WHERE demo_no=#{demoNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_demo_order SET status=#{status},payment_id=#{paymentId},paid_amount=#{paidAmount}, paid_at=#{paidAt},source_event_id=#{eventId},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='CREATED' AND source_event_id IS NULL
